title: Early Termination Fee Schedule for Beacon Ridge Business Plans
content:
This schedule sets the early termination fee terms of every Small Business Electricity Supply plan: the fee method, the damages rate, the minimum fee, the flat fee, the free windows and the drop timing.

## Fee method and amounts

| Plan | Fee method | Damages rate per remaining kWh | Minimum fee | Flat fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable | none | 0.0000 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 | flat | 0.0000 USD | 0.00 USD | 250.00 USD |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 24 | per remaining kWh | 0.0125 USD | 150.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 36 | per remaining kWh | 0.0150 USD | 200.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Beacon Ridge Business Green 24 | per remaining kWh | 0.0125 USD | 150.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Beacon Ridge Business Green 36 | per remaining kWh | 0.0150 USD | 200.00 USD | 0.00 USD |

## Free windows and waiver terms

| Plan | Free window before contract end (calendar days) | Free days at the start of an automatically renewed term (calendar days) | No fee on a move to a Beacon Ridge commercial and industrial contract |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable | 0 | 0 | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 | 30 | 60 | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 24 | 30 | 60 | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 36 | 45 | 60 | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Business Green 24 | 30 | 60 | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Business Green 36 | 45 | 60 | yes |

## Terms common to all six plans

- **Remaining-usage estimation basis:** the site's annual kWh usage prorated by the remaining months.
- **Drop timing:** a cancellation drop takes effect on the site's next scheduled meter read.

## Definitions

- The **fee method** is one of three: none (no fee), flat (the flat fee) or per remaining kWh (the damages rate applied to each remaining kWh, subject to the minimum fee under that method).
- The **damages rate** is the liquidated damages rate applied to each remaining kWh under the per-remaining-kWh method, to 4 decimals.
- The **minimum fee** is the minimum fee under the per-remaining-kWh method; the **flat fee** is the fee under the flat method.
- The **free window** is the number of calendar days immediately before contract end during which a cancellation carries no early termination fee.
- The **automatic-renewal free days** are the calendar days at the start of an automatically renewed term during which a cancellation carries no early termination fee.

## Points of reading

- Under Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable the fee method is none, so the amount columns read 0 for that plan.
- Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 is the only plan on the flat method; its damages rate and minimum fee read 0 because they belong to the per-remaining-kWh method.
- The two 36-month plans carry the longer free window (45 days) and the higher damages rate (0.0150 USD) and minimum fee (200.00 USD); the two 24-month plans carry 30 days, 0.0125 USD and 150.00 USD.
